description: Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining: wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. For a request to recommend an excluded category, explain this scope without a catalogue lookup; an empty search is not how to establish this exclusion. This connection cannot place orders or take payments: decline a purchasing request without a lookup. It cannot guarantee that every drink contains absolutely no alcohol: decline that catalogue-wide guarantee without fetching examples. Individual drink questions may use the tools to check declared wording and evidence. Do not invent a product or producer for these refusals.
